translations.web: Of the first of your dough, you shall give to Yahweh a wave offering throughout your generations.
translations.bsb: Throughout your generations, you are to give the LORD an offering from the first of your dough.
translations.kjv: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the LORD an heave offering in your generations.
translations.asv: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto Jehovah a heave-offering throughout your generations.
